name: Latitude Payment App Gateway for WooCommerce
author: latitudefinancial

sections.description: This plugin provides a simple and secure integration for WooCommerce Merchant partners to control their products that are allowed on Interest Free plans, and to accept the instant Interest Free payments from their Customers. The Customer’s payment journey will leverage Latitude’s PCI-compliant hosted payment page.
sections.installation:
This section outlines the steps to install the Latitude Payment App plugin.

  1. Search for plugin with name “Latitude Payment App”.
  2. Install and Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go WooCommerce Settings –> Payment Gateways and configure your Latitude Payment App plugin.
